facts.claim: Reverse DCF: cash proxy = per-share after-tax realized income (NTM $5.70), cost of equity 10%, terminal 3%: implied 8.1% a year vs base 10% => 'below' (thin margin)
facts.source: Recomputed (reproduces 8.07% at Ke 10%). Programme parameters: 10-yr UST 5.17% (25 Sep 2026) + Blume beta 1.42 (5-yr weekly vs SPY, d2_adjclose; raw 1.63) x ERP 4.14% = Ke 11.05%. After-tax realized income adds back equity compensation: TTM $704.0m pre-tax (FY25 506.4+234.2, less H1-25 259.2+163.8, plus H1-26 318.4+68.0; Ex-99.2 reconciliations), of which $565.6m excludes acquisition-related. At 25% tax shield on 362.4m shares: $1.17/share ($1.46 with acquisition-related)
facts.source_value: Cash base after SBC = $5.70 - $1.17 = $4.53. Implied 10-year growth: 13.4% at Ke 11.05%; 11.2% at Ke 10.0%; 15.2% at Ke 12.0%; 14.3% at Ke 11.05% with all equity compensation deducted. With Ke 11.05% but no SBC deduction: 10.2%. Value at the dossier's 10% base: $95.7 (Ke 11.05%) or $112.0 (Ke 10%) vs price $122.01
facts.note: Method defects: (i) 10% Ke is not UST 5.17% + beta x ERP; (ii) realized income excludes equity compensation (an SBC add-back). Corrected implied growth exceeds the 10% base in every SBC-burdened case => implied_vs_base 'below' -> 'above'
